title: capacity-runway-tokens-qps-by-region-2026q2
summary: Working runway plan for Hosted API peak projections across US/EU/APAC for 2026 Q2. Focus: tokens/sec and QPS targets, conservative headroom policy, GPU fleet mix needed under 3 surge scenarios, operational notes and immediate action items.
content:
Purpose:
Quick, operational plan to estimate how many GPUs and what headroom we need by region to safely absorb expected traffic growth and common surge modes (marketing spikes, model rollouts, region failovers). This is an internal working sheet — assumptions will change.

Key assumptions (short):
- Baseline request mix: 70% short-chat (avg 40 tokens req, 120 tokens resp), 20% long-gen (avg 512 tokens resp), 10% embeddings/rerank.
- Average tokens per API call (weighted) = 120 tokens.
- Model family mix (hosted): 50% small-medium (7B/13B opt), 40% large (34B-70B q4), 10% embeddings/encoder-only.
- Effective throughput per GPU (tokens/sec): A100-80GB (fp16) ~ 55k tps for small/med; H100 ~ 85k tps for small/med, large models scale down to ~18–30k tps on H100 (varies). Use conservative 60% of best-case benchmark.
- Target steady-state utilization = 60% (for slotting, autoscale reaction, KV/cache efficiency); peak headroom target = 1.6x above 5-min peak forecast.

Scenarios (per-region):
- Base: observed 30-day P95 traffic baseline, modest growth +15% next 90 days.
- Marketing surge: 3x baseline for 3 hours (promo + newsletter + partner launch).
- Failover + Holiday: region receives failover from adjacent region (1.8x) + seasonal uplift (2.5x combined) for up to 6 hours.

Quick matrix (CSV rows below). Columns: region, baseline_qps, baseline_tokens_per_sec, base_gpu_need, marketing_surge_gpu_need, failover_surge_gpu_need, recommended_reserved_pool

Table (conservative throughput numbers with 60% util):
us-east, 1200 qps, 144000 tokens/sec, 24 GPUs (H100 equiv), 72 GPUs, 44 GPUs, 30 GPUs
us-west, 800 qps, 96000 tokens/sec, 16 GPUs, 48 GPUs, 28 GPUs, 20 GPUs
eu-west, 600 qps, 72000 tokens/sec, 12 GPUs, 36 GPUs, 21 GPUs, 14 GPUs
apac-sg, 350 qps, 42000 tokens/sec, 7 GPUs, 21 GPUs, 13 GPUs, 8 GPUs

Notes on calculations (short):
- baseline_tokens_per_sec = baseline_qps * 120 avg tokens/call
- effective_gpu_tps_assumed = 85k tps (H100 small/med) * 0.6 = 51k tps. For large-model-dominant traffic, substitute 25k tps per GPU; our mixed mix weighted avg -> round down to 48k tps per GPU for safety. We use 48k in rounding to GPUs above.
- GPU counts rounded up to nearest whole and then +10% operational buffer for scheduling fragmentation -> final numbers in table reflect that buffer.

Fleet mix guidance:
- Prefer majority H100 where latency-sensitive small/med workloads dominate (US regions). H100 for us-east/us-west reserve pools.
- Keep a small fleet of A100-80GB for lower-cost long-gen heavy workloads where throughput per dollar is favorable and batchable.
- Spot/T4: use for embeddings and non-latency batch workloads only. Don’t route critical chat traffic to T4.

Headroom policy (proposed):
- Reserved capacity per region = recommended_reserved_pool in table (cover 1.25x baseline steady-state and reduce immediate autoscale latency).
- Burst autoscale to cloud pool up to marketing_surge_gpu_need (pre-warmed fast-path) for up to 6h. Pre-warming requires instance types with warm images and cached KV checkpoints.
- Cross-region failover enabled only after local capacity hits 90% sustained for >3m; failing over to nearest region with fallback model family (e.g., 34B -> 13B) to reduce GPU tps pressure.

Operational impacts & TODOs:
- TODO: INF-8342 — add pre-warm playbook for marketing spikes (image baking + KV seeding). Owner: Marco. Due: 2026-03-05.
- TODO: Validate H100 throughput numbers on 70B quantized models in eu-west lab; ticket: QPERF-412. Owner: Danielle. Due: 2026-02-28.
- TODO: Update routing policy to prefer A100 for large-gen batch jobs during off-peak to reduce H100 contention. Owner: Liu. Due: 2026-03-10.

Risks and open questions (notes-to-self):
- Synthetic benchmarks vs. real mix gap — bench overestimates throughput for real multi-tenant noise. Add +15% fudge where tenant variance high.
- Cost tradeoffs: reserving more H100 reduces latency but raises committed spend — need finance signoff for recommended_reserved_pool in us-east.
- Cross-region egress/latency when failing over large sessions: must checkpoint KV frequently to avoid full prompt re-send.

Quick decisions needed for exec review:
- Approve recommended_reserved_pool in us-east/us-west (30 + 20 GPUs) to meet 1.25x steady baseline across next 90 days.
- Approve capped burst budget to allow autoscale to marketing_surge levels for up to 6 hours (cost estimate attached in separate sheet).

End notes: this is a working runway; reconcile with finance sheet and run a 2-week stress e2e on the staging control plane to measure autoscale reaction and KV checkpoint costs.
